# Operator captures

`probe_context` writes fresh redacted responses here. These can contain publisher
page text and stay Git-ignored pending redistribution review. The key and account
metadata other than credits consumed are removed. Do not commit a full article
as an openly licensed fixture. Golden manifests reference the short retained
Arganil evidence already supplied in `data/demo/arganil-early/`.

Every operator command requires `--ceiling`; an uncertain charge stops the run.
`news` uses Portuguese web search with date operators because the separate news
index has no verified Portuguese publisher coverage. Search date filters are
discovery hints, never proof of historical publication/availability.
